headline: Ukraine’s drone pioneers bring battle-tested tech and high-skilled jobs to Britain
summary_en: Ukrainian drone firm UFORCE is expanding UK operations, bringing battle-tested technology and high-skilled jobs to Britain.
summary_zh: 乌克兰无人机公司UFORCE扩大在英业务，带来实战技术和高端就业。
watch_en: High-skilled jobs are coming to Britain as Ukrainian drone pioneers UFORCE expand their UK operations.
watch_zh: 乌克兰无人机企业UFORCE扩展英国业务，带来高端就业机会。
excerpt: High-skilled jobs are coming to Britain as Ukrainian drone pioneers UFORCE expand their UK operations, bringing battle-tested technology developed on the frontline to the UK.
